scripts.push xcode: npm run build && npm run ios:sync && npm run ios:open
scripts.ios:update: npm run build && npm run ios:sync
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:update && npm run ios:open
scripts.android:update: npm run build && npm run android:sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:update && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:update && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./android/gradlew -p android bundleRelease
